rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a published account of a person's life.

rows.note: Use this when referring to biography as the practice or craft of writing life stories rather than to an individual book.

example.english: Biography writing isn't just copying information together; you also have to bring out the person's character.
example.traditional: 傳記寫作唔係淨係將資料抄埋一齊，仲要寫出人物性格。
